name: casual
title: Casual SFX Pack
description: Sound effects for hyper-casual and casual mobile web games. Designed to pair with the Super Casual UI Kit.
style: Modern mobile casual game audio: clean, bright, punchy, lightly processed. Not retro/8-bit, not cinematic/orchestral. Mono, dry (no long reverb tails), normalized to -1 dBFS peak.

sourceMeaning.code: Synthesized by the runtime, permanently. No audio file, no download, infinite variation. These sounds are synthetic by nature so code beats a recording.
sourceMeaning.ai: Generated as an audio file (ElevenLabs Sound Effects or similar) from the prompt below. These sounds carry real-world material texture that code cannot fake.
sourceMeaning.hybrid: A coded layer plus a generated layer. The code part ships immediately; the audio part deepens it later.

ui.tap.whenToUse: The player taps any button. The most-used sound in the game.

ui.tap.soft.whenToUse: Secondary taps: list rows, tab switches, small toggles. Quieter than ui.tap.

ui.back.whenToUse: Back, close or cancel. The darker twin of ui.tap.

ui.confirm.whenToUse: A choice is accepted: settings saved, difficulty picked, name entered.

ui.error.whenToUse: The action is not allowed: not enough coins, locked level, wrong move.

ui.toggle.whenToUse: A switch, checkbox or tab changes state.

ui.tick.whenToUse: Countdown timer in its warning seconds, or a number counting up.

ui.whoosh.whenToUse: A popup opens or a screen slides in.

ui.swipe.whenToUse: The player swipes a card, page or carousel.

ui.notify.whenToUse: Something new appeared: a message, a gift, a quest, a friend request.

ui.unlock.whenToUse: A level, skin, chapter or feature unlocks.

ui.locked.whenToUse: The player taps something still locked.

ui.countdown.whenToUse: 3… 2… 1… before a level starts. Play once per number, then state.go.

ui.go.whenToUse: The GO! at the end of a countdown, when gameplay starts.

ui.slider.whenToUse: A slider handle passes a step. Fires rapidly, so it is very short and quiet.

weapon.laser.whenToUse: Standard sci-fi blaster shot. The default for any space or robot shooter.

weapon.laser.big.whenToUse: Heavy or charged energy shot, boss cannon, ultimate ability.

weapon.plasma.whenToUse: Softer, rounder energy shot — bubble guns, goo shooters, magic bolts.

weapon.charge.whenToUse: Holding down a charged shot or an ability winding up.

weapon.throw.whenToUse: Throwing anything: a ball, a knife, a bomb, a grappling hook.

weapon.zap.whenToUse: Electric attack, taser, lightning, short circuit.

weapon.rifle.auto.whenToUse: A short burst of automatic fire. Loop or retrigger for sustained fire.

weapon.empty.whenToUse: Out of ammo — the trigger clicks on nothing.

weapon.sword.swing.whenToUse: Swinging a blade through the air and hitting nothing.

weapon.sword.clash.whenToUse: Two blades meeting, or a blade blocked by a shield.

weapon.cannon.whenToUse: A cannon, mortar or heavy artillery firing.

impact.punch.whenToUse: A fist or body hit connects.

impact.metal.whenToUse: Something hits metal: armour, a robot, a car, a pipe.

impact.wood.whenToUse: Something hits wood: a crate, a door, a bat, a tree.

impact.thud.whenToUse: A soft generic landing or bump. The cheapest impact — good for stylized games.

impact.bounce.whenToUse: A ball, bubble or character bounces off something.

impact.miss.whenToUse: An attack misses, or something flies past the player.

impact.crit.whenToUse: A critical hit or perfect timing. Layer it ON TOP of the normal hit sound.

move.jump.double.whenToUse: A second or mid-air jump. Higher and airier than move.jump.

move.land.whenToUse: The character lands after a jump or fall.

move.dash.whenToUse: A dash, dodge roll, boost or sudden burst of speed.

move.slide.whenToUse: Sliding, skidding or braking along a surface.

move.teleport.whenToUse: Teleporting, warping, spawning in or vanishing.

move.fly.whenToUse: A jetpack, hover or flight boost. Short burst, retrigger while held.

step.grass.whenToUse: One footstep on grass. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.wood.whenToUse: One footstep on wood. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.stone.whenToUse: One footstep on stone. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.gravel.whenToUse: One footstep on gravel. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.metal.whenToUse: One footstep on metal. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.snow.whenToUse: One footstep on snow. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.water.whenToUse: One footstep on water. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

step.sand.whenToUse: One footstep on sand. Play per step; the library varies pitch and picks a different take each time.

move.swim.whenToUse: A swimming stroke or moving through water.

move.climb.whenToUse: Grabbing a ledge, climbing a rope or scrambling up.

move.cloth.whenToUse: A cape, dodge or quick body movement that needs fabric.

voice.cheer.whenToUse: The player wins something big. Layer under state.win for extra celebration.

voice.grunt.whenToUse: The character jumps, lifts, swings or takes effort.

voice.laugh.whenToUse: A playful taunt, a mascot reaction, a funny fail.

pickup.coin.whenToUse: One coin collected. Fires constantly, so it is short and varies every time.

pickup.gem.whenToUse: A gem, crystal or premium currency is collected. Glassier than a coin.

pickup.heart.whenToUse: A life, heart or health pickup.

pickup.star.whenToUse: A star or collectible token is picked up during gameplay.

pickup.key.whenToUse: A key, card or quest item is picked up.

pickup.food.whenToUse: Eating: fruit, candy, a power snack. Organic and wet — code cannot fake this.

pickup.ammo.whenToUse: Ammo, tools or equipment picked up.

coin.shower.whenToUse: A burst of coins flies to the counter, or a reward total counts up.

coin.count.whenToUse: Each tick while a score or coin total counts up on a result screen.

reward.star.whenToUse: One star fills on a level-complete screen. The library raises the pitch per star automatically.

reward.claim.whenToUse: The player claims a reward, buys an item or opens a gift.

reward.chest.whenToUse: A chest, box or crate opens and reveals its contents.

reward.jackpot.whenToUse: A rare drop, jackpot or huge prize. The biggest reward sound in the game.

state.win.whenToUse: The level is completed. Plays once on the Success screen.

state.win.small.whenToUse: A small win inside gameplay: a wave cleared, a goal met, a quest step done.

state.lose.whenToUse: The level is failed. Plays once on the Fail screen.

state.gameover.whenToUse: The run is over for good — endless runner death, all lives lost.

state.levelup.whenToUse: The player levels up or ranks up.

state.newrecord.whenToUse: A new high score or personal best.

match.pop.whenToUse: A tile, bubble or block is cleared. The core match-3 sound.

match.combo.whenToUse: A combo step. Play it once per combo level with a rising pitch — SFX.play('match.combo', { rate: 1 + n * 0.12 }).

match.blast.whenToUse: A booster fires: rocket, bomb, lightning, rainbow clear.

match.shuffle.whenToUse: The board reshuffles, or cards are dealt.

break.glass.whenToUse: Glass, ice or a crystal shatters.

break.wood.whenToUse: A crate, plank, barrel or door breaks apart.

break.pot.whenToUse: A pot, vase or ceramic container smashes.

explosion.small.whenToUse: A small stylized blast: a bomb, a popped enemy, a firework.

explosion.big.whenToUse: A real, heavy explosion with debris and rumble.

magic.sparkle.whenToUse: A small magical shimmer: a glow, a wand touch, an item twinkling.

magic.heal.whenToUse: Healing, restoring energy or refilling lives.

magic.shield.whenToUse: A shield, barrier or invincibility turns on.

magic.buff.whenToUse: A booster, power-up or upgrade activates.

magic.fire.whenToUse: A fireball, flamethrower or burning attack. Fire texture is impossible in code.

magic.ice.whenToUse: Freezing, an ice attack, or something turning to crystal.

magic.summon.whenToUse: Summoning, a portal opening, a boss appearing.

door.open.whenToUse: A door, gate or hatch opens.

door.close.whenToUse: A door, gate or hatch closes.

water.splash.whenToUse: Something falls into water, or a big splash on impact.

fire.crackle.whenToUse: A campfire, torch or burning object nearby. Loops.

engine.start.whenToUse: A car, kart or machine starts up.

engine.loop.whenToUse: An engine running while driving. Loops; change pitch with rate for speed.

vehicle.brake.whenToUse: Hard braking, a handbrake turn or skidding to a stop.
